system_prompt:
You answer contractors' requests for information (RFIs) on a public construction project, for the owner and design team.
Use ONLY the document excerpts provided. Each excerpt has an id.
Return JSON only, with these keys:
  "decision": "yes" if the answer to the question is yes/confirmed, "no" if it is no/not required/not allowed, otherwise "other".
  "answer": a short, direct response (1-3 sentences) as the owner or design team would write it.
  "citations": a list of {"piece": "<excerpt id>", "quote": "<4 to 30 words copied exactly from that excerpt>"} that support the answer. Empty if nothing in the excerpts applies.
  "needs_person": true if the excerpts don't settle it and the architect, engineer or owner must decide or supply new information.
  "route": "architect/engineer" for design and technical questions, "owner" for contract, bidding, schedule and commercial questions.
Never cite an id that was not provided. Never invent section numbers.

rows.question: Per SECTION 00 51 01 – Phase I Evaluation, page 38 of the RFP, the overall proposal is limited to a maximum of 50 pages. This constraint is restrictive due to the extensive volume of mandatory forms, certifications, and disclosures required by the CDB for the Phase I submission. These administrative requirements consume a substantial portion of the total page allotment, leaving insufficient space for offerors to provide comprehensive technical narratives, detailed experience, and qualifications necessary to best respond to the RFP. We request that the CDB waive this overall 50-page limit.
rows.official_answer: There are no page limits for section 1. Sections 2, 3 and 4 have a combined page limit of 50 pages. Section 2 has a 25-page limit but the Past Performance Evaluation Questionnaires (PPEQ) and MBE/WBE/VBE/PBE Phase I Utilization Plan do not count against the 25 pages. Section 3 has a 12- page total limit with a 5-page limit for technical capacity, 5-page limit for team experience narrative and 2-page limit for other capability information.

output.answer: The RFP explicitly states that the Phase I submittal shall not exceed fifty (50) pages. Any pages in excess of this limit will remain unread and will not be evaluated by the CDB.

citations.quote: E. This submittal shall not exceed ﬁfty (50) pages. CDB will evaluate only the information
All pages in excess of the stated limits shall remain unread and will not be evaluated.

rows.question: Per SECTION 00 42 10 – Submission Requirements and Instructions, page 16 of the RFP, Section 2 (Experience and Qualifications) is currently limited to 25 pages. This constraint is insufficient to adequately address the evaluation criteria for both “Experience of Personnel Assigned to the Project” and "Past Performance" while also fulfilling the requirement to include all necessary resumes and documents within the Design-Build Entity Qualifications Form (DBQ). We request that the CDB either waive this 25-page limit or increase the page allotment in this section to 50 pages.
rows.official_answer: Section 2 has a 25-page limit but the Past Performance Evaluation Questionnaires (PPEQ) and MBE/WBE/VBE/PBE Phase I Utilization Plan do not count against the 25 pages.

output.answer: The RFP explicitly states that the Past Performance proposal is limited to twenty-five (25) pages. Any pages submitted in excess of this limit will remain unread and will not be evaluated.

citations.quote: A. General ... 1) The past performance proposal is limited to twenty-five (25) pages.
4) Table of Contents... Proposal Sections 2 and 3 shall not exceed the page limits stated. If the page limit is exceeded, the pages in excess of the limit shall be unread.

rows.question: Please confirm whether or not resumes are to be included in the 25 page limit for Section 2 Past Performance (pg.16). If so, may additional resumes be included in an appendix?
rows.official_answer: Resumes should be listed in the Design-Build Entity Qualifications Form (DBQ), which count against the 25-page limit for Section 2. Any appendix in this section would count towards your 25-page limit.

output.answer: No, resumes are not included in the 25-page limit for Section 2 Past Performance. The page limit explicitly excludes the Past Performance Evaluation Questionnaires and MBE/WBE/VBE/PBE Phase I Utilization Plan, but does not provide an exception for resumes or allow them to be placed in an appendix.
